params.description: If present, wpArea is a form object name (Text); if omitted, wpArea is a 4D Write Pro object variable or field.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets the cursor into the frame designated by frameSelector (and, for a text box frame, textBoxID) in the 4D Write Pro wpArea area.
overloadMerges.note: star_operator_dual_signature (category C): both doc syntax lines are one overload where the leading '*' only toggles whether wpArea is a form-object name string or a variable/field reference; merged per the same convention as WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION / SET LIST ITEM PROPERTIES.

jointConstraints.rule: textBoxID must be passed when frameSelector is wk text box; if it is omitted, or no text box with that id exists (or no page corresponds to its anchor conditions), the command does nothing. textBoxID is ignored when frameSelector is not wk text box.

constraints: The command can only be used if wpArea is associated with a form object currently displayed in the current form/page.
If frameSelector requests a header/footer frame that does not exist for the selected section (or its sub-section type distinction), the command does nothing (no error is generated).
